Job Profile Summary
The Data Scientist II leverages modeling and analytics techniques to support data-driven decision making across the business

Primary Duties and Responsibilities
Ensures processes and policies are aligned with departmental strategies and roadmaps
May mentor junior data scientists and/or analysts
Interacts and collaborates closely with data and business peers across business units
Researches, develops, and maintains data pipelines, statistical/ML models, and/or advanced analyses
Delivers analytical and modeling solutions through testing, validation, and refinement and with minimal manager oversight.
Proactively collaborates within the data science team to supplement domain and technical expertise to drive projects forward.
Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations
Other duties as assigned

Required Experience and Education
3+ years of industry or other quantitative technical fields (which may include academia).
2+ years of work experience working with SQL, R, and/or Python to query, manipulate and analyze data
2+ years experience building data models, using more advanced analytics methods, statistical modeling, and/or data processing

Preferred Experience and Education
Masters degree in a quantitative or technical field
Knowledge of or previous work experience in health care or health insurance

metadata.name: Job Description
metadata.value:
The Executive Recruiter will be responsible for owning and executing executive level searches. This person will need to be well-versed in the full life cycle executive search process (including candidate generation and development, senior client management and offer/negotiation.)

The role will include the following responsibilities:
Oversee the management and execution of full-life cycle executive searches by developing the sourcing and recruiting strategies across select/designated functional areas
Calibrating candidates with hiring managers
Developing those prospects into candidates, engaging them and performing initial assessment (Pitch Calls)
Participating in client update meetings on active searches and preparing reports
Conducting on-site interviews and participating in debriefs; performing reference checks and creatively negotiating complex executive compensation packages.
Support the Senior Director, Executive Recruiting on searches
Develop search strategies, conduct research, and present qualified candidates for executive searches

Required Experience and Education
6+ years of experience within Executive Recruiting
3+ years of leading VP+ level searches
1+ years of project management experience; the ability to follow-through on individual and team-wide goals, plans and projects.
1+ years experience building, and executing, strategies for staffing projects.
1+ years of experience pulling insights from data, and utilizing insights to advise hiring leaders, and influence business decisions.
 
Preferred Experience and Education
Experience in agency and in-house recruiting 
Experience recruiting at a startup and/or within the healthcare industry.
Experience building workforce forecasts
Experience partnering with staffing partners/vendors

Job Profile Summary
The Sr. Manager of HR Governance is responsible for leading and managing key HR compliance functions including visa & immigration, health and safety, employee policy, and processes that support talent risk analysis. 


Primary Duties and Responsibilities
Oversee all aspects of visa and immigration processes to ensure legal compliance for employees and be a strategic partner in evolving program support based on changing U.S. landscape
Lead health & safety initiatives, audits, and training in accordance with local, state, and federal regulations
Design, update, and communicate HR policies and procedures aligned with organizational goals and legal requirements
Monitor and ensure compliance with labor laws, employment regulations, and internal HR standards to inform on adjustments as needed to policy and practices
Identify and evaluate HR-related risks impacting the organization and develop mitigation strategies, contingency plans, and defined processes for consistency
Lead the HR Governance team through strategy execution and act as first point of escalation
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders and external partners including but not limited to People, IT, Comms, Legal, and supporting vendors
Engage as a project manager for annual handbook renewal and company reduction in force efforts
Demonstrate integrity, fairness and professionalism in all business dealings that require high confidentiality

Experience with Workday HRIS

Job Profile Summary
A Group Product Manager leads a team of Product Managers and is focused on defining product strategy, identifying and prioritizing solutions, and leading cross-team execution for a given product domain.
The role works closely with partners across cross-functional teams to support Oscar’s vision, strategy, and roadmap for  technology investments 
The Group Product Manager and their team is responsible for becoming subject matter experts in their aligned business and product domain, understanding the challenges, needs and outcomes they are accountable to drive.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities
Helping to define the vision and strategy for a set of product domains, owning road maps focused on improving the operational processes, iterating and evolving provider data structures in the aligned product area
Partnering closely with stakeholders including cross functional department leaders across the business including Product, Design, Engineering, Business Development and Marketing to define strategy and roadmap
Collaborating with Engineering and Product leadership to make resource trade-off decisions and to ensure teams are working together effectively
Provide recommendations to leadership for product enhancements to improve existing products and development of new ones 
Develop operating models for new products in partnership with leadership 
Partner with +Oscar leadership, Marketing, and Comms to ensure +Oscar is positioned as a thought leader at key industry events
Mentoring, coaching and providing support to a team of Product Managers
Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations (DO NOT REMOVE - REQUIRED)
Other duties as assigned (DO NOT REMOVE - REQUIRED)
 
Required Experience and Education
7+ years of product experience
4+ years of people management experience
 
Preferred Experience and Education
Comfort in working in highly collaborative environments while ensuring the team is always driving towards a decision
Excellent analytical and quantitative skills; proved experience using data to identify opportunities, test theories and evaluate success.
Experience as an end-to-end thinker; the ability to look at a problem and create a solution all the way from top-level goals to smaller details
Ability to influence and manage stakeholders at all levels and experience working across all levels of leadership using strong communication and structured thinking
